instructions: You are one of two independent readers for a public record that scores theories of consciousness. A study counts toward a prediction only if that prediction was on record, in a dated publication by the theory's own proponents, before the study first appeared. A study that says it set out to test a theory tests nothing if the prediction was first written in the same paper (or the study's own registration). When the dates or the commitment are unclear, the study is not counted. Read the passages and dates. Decide: BEFORE (the earlier passage commits the theory to this prediction, and it predates the study), NOT-BEFORE (it does not), or UNCLEAR. Answer in JSON: {"verdict": "before"|"not-before"|"unclear", "reason": "two to four plain sentences", "unsure": true|false, "unsure_why": "..."}.

core_claim.quote: The physical correspondent of an experience is not the substrate as such but the Φ-structure specified by the substrate in its current state.

source.citation: Albantakis L, Barbosa L, Findlay G, Grasso M, Haun AM, Marshall W, Mayner WGP, Zaeemzadeh A, Boly M, Juel BE, Sasai S, Fujii K, David I, Hendren J, Lang JP, Tononi G. Integrated information theory (IIT) 4.0: formulating the properties of phenomenal existence in physical terms. PLOS Computational Biology 19(10):e1011465, 2023

prediction.statement: For as long as a stimulus is consciously experienced, a content-specific pattern of activity persists in posterior cortex.

first_stated.passage: In sum, GNW predicts a phasic ignition of the workspace followed by a decay (until a new content is consciously experienced), while IIT predicts, independent of any phasic transient, a sustained content-specific activity pattern persisting for as long as the stimulus is consciously experienced.

source.citation: Melloni L, Mudrik L, Pitts M, et al. Preregistration file v1, January 2019: Accelerating research on consciousness: an adversarial collaboration to test contradictory predictions of global neuronal workspace and integrated information theory. OSF project mbcfy, component wz8mj

prediction.test_for: Content-specific activity and information in posterior cortex last as long as the stimulus, and track its duration.
prediction.test_against: Posterior content-specific activity or information decays well before a still-visible stimulus ends.

study.name: The Cogitate Consortium's adversarial test of global workspace and integrated information theory

source.citation: Cogitate Consortium, Ferrante O, Gorska-Klimowska U, Henin S, et al. Adversarial testing of global neuronal workspace and integrated information theories of consciousness. Nature 642:133-142, 2025

passages.text: In this view, the temporal persistence of a conscious experience should be concomitant with the state of the physical neural substrate that specifies that experience, such that if an experience extends over a longer period, so should its physical substrate with its specific state and connectivity.

source.citation: Melloni L, Mudrik L, Pitts M, et al. Preregistration file v1, January 2019: Accelerating research on consciousness: an adversarial collaboration to test contradictory predictions of global neuronal workspace and integrated information theory. OSF project mbcfy, component wz8mj
